prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='catboost', seasonality_champion='rf', recommended_method='stl_hierarchical_stacking'. Narrative: DWT_rf dominates overall RMSE (301.2) with perfect trend correlation (1.0) and excellent seasonality capture (0.9684). The trend champion catboost and seasonality champion rf split responsibilities, indicating decomposition-aware stacking can exploit complementary strengths. High RMSE spread ratio (39.7) and model disagreement suggest weighted combinations outperform single models, while autocorrelated residuals in top models indicate residual structure remains exploitable via STL-hierarchical stacking.
